name: client-storage-getblob-root-ref
description: firebase/storage getBlob(ref(storage)) on the root reference: observes the browser bundle client-side root preflight (throws FirebaseError storage/invalid-root-operation with zero network requests) alongside the Node bundle environment guard.

browserRootRef.message: Firebase Storage: The operation 'getBlob' cannot be performed on a root reference, create a non-root reference using child, such as .child('file.png'). (storage/invalid-root-operation)

nodeEntryRootRef.message: getBlob() is only available in Browser-like environments
